_comment: botl.c eval_notify_windowport_field() and get_hilite() choose a status highlight whatever 'statushilites' says; wintty.c render_status() applies iflags.hilite_delta only when it draws. The debug-mode Healer drops from experience level 3 to 2, which leaves 39 of 40 points, so BL_XP has a nonzero percentage. In one visit to the status hilites menu it adds experience-level/always/cyan&dim and then a power rule; the second 'Added hilite' message runs bot() while hilite_delta is still 0, and BL_XP, whose percentage is computed only once it has a rule, changes from 0 and takes the cyan rule. Leaving the menu sets hilite_delta to 3, and the redrawn status line shows Xp:2 in cyan. The port used to skip the rule while hilite_delta was 0 and kept the percentage current without any rule.
